Per-event temporal/spatial edge-correction factors for trigger re-estimation

Source: R/trigger_reestimate.R
trigger_edge_correction.Rd

Computes, for every event, how much of its triggering kernels' mass would have been observable given the study period's end date and the study region's boundary – the correction factors the original script calls excite.temporal.edge.correction / excite.spatial.edge.correction – plus the pooled "repetance" surfaces (temporal.repetance / spatial.repetance in the original) used to correct the re-estimated kernels for how many events could have produced an observation at each offset, given the same boundaries.

Usage

trigger_edge_correction(
  events,
  temporal_trigger,
  spatial_trigger,
  cache_dir,
  marks = NULL
)

Arguments

events

A semihawkes_events object.

temporal_trigger

A semihawkes_trigger_temporal object.

spatial_trigger

A semihawkes_trigger_spatial object.

cache_dir

Directory previously populated by trigger_spatial_marks() for the same events/spatial_trigger.

marks

Optional: the marks in cache_dir, already read into a list with one logical matrix per event (as fit_semihawkes() does once per fit, so they are not read from disk at every iteration). NULL (the default) reads them from cache_dir.

Value

A list of class "semihawkes_trigger_edge_correction" with temporal_edge_correction, spatial_edge_correction (numeric vectors, one value per event), temporal_repetance (numeric vector on temporal_trigger$base), spatial_repetance (matrix on spatial_trigger$x/y), and temporal_repetance_fun/ spatial_repetance_fun (ready-to-use evaluators).

Details

Requires trigger_spatial_marks() to have already populated cache_dir for every event in events.

Examples

ev <- prepare_events(sim_events, sim_region, date_col = "date",
                     end_date = "2022-01-01")
#> The modelled study period ends on 2021-12-29, the day after the last event. `end_date` (2022-01-01) is used only to select events and to label outputs.
ev <- add_adaptive_bandwidth(ev, k = 5, min_dist = 150, min_bandwidth = 300)
ev <- add_bg_integral(ev, n_mc = 500, seed = 1)
tt <- trigger_temporal_init()
ts <- trigger_spatial_init(x_range = 2000, x_step = 250)
cache_dir <- tempfile("spHawkes_marks_")
trigger_spatial_marks(ev, ts, cache_dir = cache_dir)
ec <- trigger_edge_correction(ev, tt, ts, cache_dir)
ec
#> <semihawkes_trigger_edge_correction>
#>   98 events
